I will never understand how people like this can say that the Tenth Amendment supports their position. The Tenth Amendment specifically states that the federal government possesses only the powers granted to it by the Constitution, while remaining powers are reserved for the states. But powers granted to the federal government by the Constitution include citizenship rights and the equal protection of the laws under the Equal Protection Clause of the Fourteenth Amendment, as well as procedural and substantive due process, which ensures the rights and equality of all citizens under the Due Process Clause of both the Fifth Amendment and the Fourteenth Amendment. As these are powers directly granted to the federal government, they are not powers reserved to the states.
